response.reason: The chunked scan is mathematically sound: _compose is associative affine composition, the local inclusive associative_scan yields per-chunk summaries, the Hillis-Steele up-sweep plus identity-rooted down-sweep in _exclusive_chunks produces correct exclusive chunk carries (verified on C=2 and C=4 traces), and _apply_prefix composes the local inclusive prefix with the carry, exactly matching state[row,step]. All arithmetic is int64, well within range (<2^48), and padding lanes use identity maps, so edge cases like chunks=1 and non-power-of-2 chunk counts are handled correctly.
